jobs.title: Triage GH #19 + #21 — produce SCOPE.md
jobs.objective: Read docs/issues/19/SPEC.md (stale-lease recovery for repo_write jobs) and docs/issues/21/SPEC.md (serve startup clobbers retired-local-state). Produce docs/issues/19/SCOPE.md naming: (a) the file paths to change for each issue; (b) acceptance checks derived from each SPEC's Required Fixes + Definition of Done sections; (c) the test files that will prove each fix. The scope MUST stay narrow — pick the minimum viable fix per issue (e.g., for #21: serve should not init-over an existing retired-local-state; for #19: a `--force --justification` flag on `recovery requeue-stale` for repo_write OR a new `recovery operator-publish` verb). No broader refactors. Cite each acceptance check against the GH issue's section.

jobs.title: Fix GH #19 + #21 per SCOPE.md
jobs.objective: Implement the fixes named in SCOPE.md. Per the issue SPECs: (#21) serve startup must NOT init-over an existing healthy retired-local-state — attach read-or-shared, fail loudly if unreadable; documented hazard in HOW_TO_HUMAN.md. (#19) provide an operator escape hatch for repo_write stale-lease — minimum viable is a `--force --justification` flag on `recovery requeue-stale` that audit-chains the override, OR a new `recovery operator-publish` verb that bypasses the lease-active precondition. Tests under tests/ assert: (a) serve start does not modify retired-local-state when an active run is in flight (run row count + sha256 invariant); (b) `recovery requeue-stale --force --justification "..."` (or operator-publish) transitions a stale_lease job back to a claimable state with an audit-chained operator override row. Use sub-agents for each issue's cluster.

jobs.title: Verify GH #19 + #21 fixes against SPEC acceptance checks
jobs.objective: Fresh-session: read ONLY the two GH issue SPECs (docs/issues/{19,21}/SPEC.md), the SCOPE.md, the HANDOFF.md, and the changed source files. Verify each acceptance check from SCOPE.md is closed by a test that actually exercises the fix (not aspirational coverage). For #21: assert there is a test that (a) creates a populated retired-local-state, (b) starts a fresh serve process, (c) asserts the file count + checksum is unchanged. For #19: assert there is a test that (a) creates a stale_lease repo_write job, (b) runs the new operator escape verb with --justification, (c) asserts the job transitions back to claimable AND an operator-override audit row is written. Verdict accept / accept_with_findings / needs_revision.
